title: Mechanical Bookend - Bent Plate
brief:
Mechanical-only: a single bent plate bookend for a desk. Use one Mechanical part, no electronics, no wires and no power rails. Footprint, load, thickness and material require measurement. Include preparation, fabrication and a stability Test linked to the plate.

- What will power it, and what supply limits are known?
- What size, weight, or mounting constraint must it meet?
- What observable result would show that it works?

parts.name: Bent Plate Bookend
parts.detail: Single plate, bent at a single angle to form a bookend shape. Dimensions and material to be measured.

steps.title: Measure and Mark Plate Dimensions
steps.detail: Measure desired footprint, thickness, and bend angle. Mark bend line with pencil or scribe. Ensure material can be bent without cracking or warping.

steps.title: Bend Plate to Desired Angle
steps.detail: Use file or grinder to create bend. Apply force to form angle. Ensure bend is consistent and not too sharp or too shallow. No electronics or power involved.

steps.title: Stability Test with Known Load
steps.detail: Place plate on flat surface. Apply known load (e.g., 1 kg book or weight). Observe if plate remains upright. Record deflection or collapse. No power or wires involved.
